lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity circular pixel clusters are observed posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately vertical columns with variable inter-blob spacing.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from a light-colored upper edge to a shadowed lower edge.
